query:
Go to http://localhost:7770/catalogsearch/result/?q=Rivenhall . Does every Rivenhall listing stock the 2 x 9.5L pack? Answer yes or no.

Use this retrieval strategy, and note what the question actually requires.
It asks whether EVERY listing qualifies. Those two possible answers need different amounts of evidence. To answer No you need one counterexample and nothing more. To answer Yes you need to have checked all of them.
1. Open listings and check the option asked about.
2. The moment you find one that does not have it, you can answer No and stop. Name it as your evidence.
3. Only if you have opened every listing without finding a counterexample may you answer Yes.
In your answer, say how many listings you opened and which one settled it.
